description: This file defines the ModifyResourcesResponse class, a final immutable class representing the response to a ModifyResources command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods to construct instances from parameters or JSON, accessors for encapsulated data, and serialization logic.

classes.name: ModifyResourcesResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to a ModifyResources command, encapsulating the policy ID, label, status code, and headers. Provides factory methods for creation from parameters or JSON, serialization, and equality semantics.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance from policy ID, label, and headers (deprecated version accepting String policy ID).

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance from PolicyId, Label, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this response.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the Label of the PolicyEntry whose Resources were modified.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the resource path related to this response.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.
